news.title: OCC Approves Three New Trust Banks to Operate With Stablecoins and AI Agents
news.body: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted conditional approvals to Agora National Trust Bank, Catena Trust Bank, and Jiko Bank to operate as national trust banks with stablecoin and AI agent capabilities. These approvals allow the new banks to offer programmable money and AI-driven services, prompting traditional banks to accelerate their own digital product development to remain competitive against these tech-forward, regulator-backed entrants.

news.title: SBI Group Invests $25M in dtcpay to Expand Stablecoin Payments in Asia
news.body: SBI Group joined a $25 million Series A funding round for Singapore-based dtcpay, a stablecoin payments provider. With this new capital, dtcpay plans to rapidly launch new products and onboard more merchants across Asia, intensifying competition for regional payment networks and prompting rivals to pursue similar expansion strategies.

news.title: Ant International Unveils AI-Native Stack for Payments, FX, and Treasury
news.body: Ant International launched a comprehensive AI-native product suite covering payments, account management, FX, treasury, and growth operations. This rollout gives Ant a technological edge and sets a new bar for automation and intelligence in financial operations. Competing PSPs and banks will need to accelerate their own AI deployments or risk falling behind on efficiency and customer experience. The move signals a global race to embed AI deeper into core financial infrastructure.

news.title: Saudi Arabia Withdraws From China’s mBridge Cross-Border Payments Program
news.body: Saudi Arabia exited China's mBridge digital currency and cross-border payments initiative, citing concerns over bypassing dollar-based systems like Swift. The withdrawal undermines mBridge’s credibility and may prompt other participating countries to reconsider their involvement, potentially slowing the project's expansion and increasing pressure on China to address compliance with global standards.

news.title: Polymarket Faces Compliance Allegations Amid Growth Push
news.body: Polymarket is under fire for alleged compliance failures and legal risks as it prioritizes rapid growth, according to a Wall Street Journal report. The controversy threatens Polymarket’s reputation and could drive users to competitors with stronger regulatory track records. Prediction market operators now face heightened scrutiny and may see rising compliance costs as regulators respond. The episode highlights the growing importance of robust compliance in crypto-adjacent financial products.

perspective: OCC trust bank approvals and Saudi Arabia’s mBridge exit signal pivotal shifts for Jiko Bank and China’s cross-border payment ambitions.

curiosity.text: A lesser-known effect of the Dodd-Frank Act’s debit card rules: some small banks and credit unions were exempt from the interchange cap, creating a two-tier fee structure.
